title: What Shape-Shifting Buildings Is
definition: Shape-Shifting Buildings: buildings changing shape on demand.
description:
Shape-Shifting Buildings: buildings changing shape on demand. This is Future Architecture & Building at its most ambitious — transformer joints research, building logistics engineering and use-case modes operations converging on a single goal: making building hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Architecture & Building will decide engineering outcomes this century. Shape-Shifting Buildings is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working building hulls, the larger transformer joints vision stalls, and with it, the building logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Shape-Shifting Buildings in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

title: Real Research Today: Shape-Shifting Buildings
definition: Today's documented research behind Shape-Shifting Buildings.
description:
The road to Shape-Shifting Buildings is already being paved. NASA's 3D-Printed Habitat Challenge advanced off-world construction methods. Bamboo construction research (INBAR) standardizes the world's fastest-growing structure.

Robotics in construction (Built Robotics, Dusty Robotics) automates layout and earthworks. Together these programs form the transformer joints foundation that Shape-Shifting Buildings will build on — the building logistics results, the use-case modes methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as building logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2030 — First building hulls districts certified: transformer joints ass
title: 2030 — First building hulls districts certified: transformer joints ass
definition: 2030 milestone on the Shape-Shifting Buildings roadmap.
description:
First building hulls districts certified: transformer joints assembly at half the time and carbon of legacy builds.

What must be true first: the transformer joints results have to replicate outside the lab, building logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and use-case modes operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed transformer joints demonstrations, building logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting use-case modes uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Shape-Shifting Buildings
definition: Estimates Shape-Shifting Buildings readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Shape-Shifting Buildings components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a building hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Shape-Shifting Buildings Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Shape-Shifting Buildings operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Shape-Shifting Buildings installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 8101 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where transformer joints monitoring, building logistics redundancy, or use-case modes maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Shape-Shifting Buildings Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Shape-Shifting Buildings: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Shape-Shifting Buildings — buildings changing shape on demand.

Phase 1 — Prove (transformer joints): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (building logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (use-case modes): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (engineering): building hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and venues-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
